reporting-org.narrative: Netherlands Advisory Board on Impact Investing

description.narrative:
The Netherlands Advisory Board on Impact Investing (NAB) is an independent non-profit organization established in 2020. Our mission is to accelerate the growth and effectiveness of the Dutch impact investing market.
Building a Collaborative Ecosystem: We act as a hub for Dutch impact investing stakeholders, fostering action-oriented collaboration among investors, social enterprises, and experts. We work together to co-create solutions, address barriers, and ultimately achieve the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs).
Our Impact: Raising awareness: We educate the public and investors about the power of impact investing. Addressing barriers: We identify and tackle challenges hindering growth in the sector. Increasing confidence: We promote best practices and showcase successful examples of impact investing. Vision: We envision a healthy impact investing ecosystem where investments generate both financial returns and positive social and environmental impact.
Our Goal: We aim to double the size of the Dutch impact investing sector by 2025.
Founded in 2020, the NAB is a leading platform for the Dutch impact investing ecosystem. The NAB is proud of the following milestones in 2023: 1. Introduction 10% program in the financial sector 2. Attract more members for the NAB and core funding from the Dutch Ministry of Foreign Affairs for the next 4 years to build the Dutch ecosystem 3. Exchange knowledge in the financial sector 4. Publish a report on capital requirements for institutional investors and debunk perception of risk about private debt in emerging markets 5. Collaborate with the European Impact Investing Consortium to improve harmonization of norms and standards 6. Capacity growth of the organization: doubled the team and strengthened policies and processes Double Dutch impact assets under management by 2025 (10% target), with a 4% allocation for emerging markets by 2030. For more details: https://www.nabimpactinvesting.nl/post/2023-nab-impact-report

condition.narrative:
Financial Sustainability (Condition 1):
Secure core funding for the next 4 years. As mentioned, attracting members and securing core funding from the Dutch Ministry of Foreign Affairs for the next four years is crucial. This will provide financial stability for the NAB to continue its activities. Impact Growth (Condition 2):
Increase Dutch impact assets under management by 2025. The NAB aims to double Dutch impact assets under management by 2025 with a 10% target. Track progress towards this goal and adjust strategies as needed. Increase impact allocation to emerging markets by 2030. The 4% target allocation for emerging markets by 2030 is another key impact metric. Monitor progress and implement strategies to attract more investments in emerging markets. Ecosystem Development (Condition 3):
Attract more members to the NAB. A growing membership base strengthens the NAB's network and creates a more robust ecosystem. Develop strategies and incentives to attract new members. Facilitate knowledge exchange in the financial sector. The NAB should continue facilitating knowledge exchange to inform and educate stakeholders in the financial sector. This can be achieved through events, publications, or online resources. Collaborate with relevant organizations. Continued collaboration with the European Impact Investing Consortium and other relevant organizations can help improve harmonization of norms and standards, benefiting the entire impact investing landscape. Organizational Capacity (Condition 4):
Maintain and develop the NAB's organizational capacity. Building on the success of doubling the team and strengthening policies in 2023, the NAB should continue to invest in its staff and internal systems to ensure efficient operations and support future growth. Monitoring and Evaluation (Condition 5):
Develop clear metrics to track progress on all the conditions. Regularly monitor progress towards these conditions and adapt strategies as needed. Consider publishing annual reports or progress updates to track achievements and demonstrate impact.

Our impact report 2023 ‘Driving the development of the Dutch impact investing ecosystem’ describes the core of the Netherlands Advisory Board on impact investing (NAB), our activities, lessons learned and future perspectives. The NAB was founded in 2020 and has the ambition to be the prime platform in the Netherlands supporting the impact investment ecosystem and to be recognized as a leading center of expertise and innovation in the sector. The NAB is focused on scaling up investments in impact and increasing effectiveness and cooperation in the Dutch impact investing sector. Our goal is to double the impact assets under management of Dutch stakeholders to 10% by 2025, with a 4% sub-target allocation for emerging markets in 2030.
